title: ActiveRecord N+1 query in controller or view
summary: Rails code loads associated records lazily while rendering a collection.
rationale: N+1 queries are a common Rails amplification pattern that increases DB load and page latency with collection size.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Use includes, preload, eager_load, counter caches, or query reshaping as appropriate.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
